body.summary: A party of adventurers descends into a vast dungeon beneath a ruined island to rescue Laios's sister Falin, who was swallowed by a Red Dragon. Stripped of supplies, they survive by hunting and cooking the dungeon's monsters, guided by the dwarf cook Senshi, and the meals become the engine of the journey. The story widens into the dungeon's ecology, the Golden Castle's cursed immortal residents, the mad sorcerer Thistle who rules it, and the Winged Lion imprisoned in its depths. ||Laios's party defeats the Red Dragon, revives Falin with forbidden magic using dragon flesh, loses her again when Thistle turns her into a chimera, and resolves to eat the dragon's flesh out of her to free her soul.||

arcs.summary: The party learns to survive on dungeon food, recruiting Senshi and mastering each monster as an ingredient.
They defeat the Red Dragon and revive Falin with forbidden magic using dragon flesh.
Thistle attacks and turns Falin into a chimera; the party resolves to defeat him.
Trapped by the shifting dungeon, they learn its patterns and meet Shuro, Kabru and the Golden Castle ghosts.
Senshi's backstory reveals the mining crew, the Griffin and the soup he has feared for years.
A Changeling ring swaps the party's races, and they plan to eat the dragon out of Falin.

motifs: cooking and eating as the measure of a creature
the dungeon as a body with Cleaners as its immune system
eggs as a metaphor for souls
the Winged Lion on Kensuke's sword
the adamant pot and mithril knife
the prophecy of the winged sword
themes: grief and the refusal to let the dead go

notable_scenes.summary: Senshi kills a Mandrake by cutting its head off before it can scream, over Marcille's book method.
The party discovers Living Armor is a colony of mollusks and cooks it.
Laios leaps into the Red Dragon's chest to strike its inverse scale.
Marcille rebuilds Falin's skeleton from dragon and Warg bones and revives her.
Thistle's ancient magic overwhelms Marcille and Falin is taken.
Senshi finally tastes Griffin soup and learns it was never the flavor he feared.
